bio.text: Darin LaHood, born and raised in Peoria, represents Illinois's 16th Congressional District in the U.S. House; he was first sworn in on September 17, 2015, after a special election.
From 2015 to 2023 he represented the 18th District, and before Congress he served four years in the Illinois State Senate starting in 2011.
He worked more than nine years as a state and federal prosecutor, including as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Las Vegas, and sits on the Ways and Means and Intelligence committees.
